name: Home
source:
A late-night cryptid chatroom, same as always. “Anyone got wild stories tonight?” Someone mentions the Half Deer. An omen, a spirit you never want to meet. 

Then, shattering glass from my kitchen. Looks like I’ve just been chosen...
